_doc: MISUMI's pre-assembly insertion nut (HNTT5) for its 5 series, 6 mm slot, M3. The standard nut: slid in from an open end before the frame is closed. Hold: MISUMI gives a tightening torque, not a pull.
name: slot-nut-6-misumi-m3-slide-in

slot.rule: Made for MISUMI's 5 series (slot width 6 mm)
slot.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

thread.rule: Thread M3, one of the sizes the table lists (M3, M4, M5)
thread.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

nut_kind.rule: A plain block with a tongue, slid in from the end of the slot
nut_kind.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

length.rule: Along the slot: 10 on the drawing
length.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

width.rule: Across the slot: 10 on the drawing
width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

height.rule: The body under the lips: E = 3.3 in the table (T = 4.1 overall)
height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, dimensioned on the drawing
tongue_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step: the drawing's overall height less the body's
tongue_height.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

nut_entry.rule: Pre-assembly insertion: slid in from an open end of the slot before the frame is closed
nut_entry.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

material.rule: Material as the table names it
material.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-559, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_559.pdf

hold.rule: The screw's proof load, 2918 N (M3, class 8.8, 580 MPa on its stress area), which is less than the nut's own: Rexroth rates its sliding block in a 6 mm slot (M5) at 3000 N. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m3 thread set (ISO 898-1)
